items.title: Claude now builds interactive websites inside canvas graphics, reviving the Flash era with real HTML
items.excerpt: Claude can now embed text, buttons, and other web elements into complex graphics and 3D effects.
items.rationale: New Claude capability: real HTML elements live inside canvas/3D graphics, which opens expressive interactive web layouts designers can prototype directly.

items.title: Lovable introduces Drafts: explore any idea in parallel without touching what's live
items.excerpt: Now you and your team can explore different versions of your project in parallel while keeping your live app unchanged.
items.rationale: Primary-source feature launch: parallel design variants on a vibe-coded app without touching production, which changes how designers explore in AI builders.

items.title: Astryx is now available in v0
items.excerpt: Astryx is now available in v0 as a design-system skill, bringing guidance, components, examples, and templates into context as v0 builds.
items.rationale: Meta's design system ships as a v0 skill, so generated UI follows real components and guidance; directly actionable for design-system teams.

items.title: Transform notes, research, and sources into interactive sites with Gemini Notebook
items.excerpt: Gemini Notebook now turns your research into interactive sites. Build project trackers and visual dashboards with Google. Create your site today.
items.rationale: New Gemini Notebook output type (interactive sites/dashboards from research), distinct from the 10-20 slides/videos feature; useful for research-to-artifact workflows.

items.title: How 1Password uses Figma Make to design for trust and certainty
items.excerpt: From autofill to AI agent approvals, every 1Password interaction counts. Here's how the design team uses Figma Make to design moments users trust.
items.rationale: Concrete team case study of prototyping AI-agent approval flows in Figma Make; practical patterns for designing trust in agentic UX.

dedup.note: No candidate was a repeat of the 30-day history. Claude canvas feature differs from the 11-16 Claude Fable 5.2 painting card and the 11-11 interactive connectors card; Gemini Notebook interactive sites is a different feature release from the 10-20 slides/videos card; 1Password Figma Make is a separate customer story from the 10-24 design-system post and the 10-23 Lufthansa Make story. Excluded: Pearl Abyss/Wccftech (cross-section brief: games only); CNET Adobe MAX slop piece and Creative Bloq Firefly trust essay (commentary on the Adobe MAX launch already published 11-11); Runway Praxis-1 (robotics, not design); Vercel agent evals (developer testing, weak design angle); UX Collective 'Why bother paying for software' (member-only opinion); DEV 'developer or designer' and 'AI loves purple' (lower-credibility blog posts); Parametric Architecture critic essay and MarketScale AIA survey (lower actionability); Claude whiteboards YouTube explainer (secondary walkthrough). Cross-section: published_urls.json is too large to read in full without grep. The picks dated 11-16 came out after the previous run's harvest, so they cannot already be published. Astryx is specific to design systems and is not on the brief's collision list.
